forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: Your role does not include access to this page.

shared.chooseLocationHint: Pick a location in the header to see this page.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Today at each location. Full reports come later.
dashboard.emptyHint: Your role does not include viewing orders at any location.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Sales, money, shifts and kitchen times by business day — each location's own calendar day.

notes.sales: Sales are completed orders on their business day, also when refunded later. Refunds count on the day they were made and are split into tax, fees and net sales in proportion to the order. Net sales exclude tax and fees.
notes.payments: Money is counted on the business day it moved, including prepayments of orders that were cancelled later.
notes.lines: Line amounts of completed orders. Fees are not part of any product; refunds are not assigned to products.
notes.taxes: Taxable amounts exclude the tax. Refunded tax is the tax part of refunds made in the period.
notes.shifts: Shifts opened in the period. Expected cash of an open shift is what the drawer should hold now.
notes.prepTimes: From the ticket reaching the kitchen to ready. Tickets slower than the location's “late” threshold count as late; cancelled tickets are left out.

filters.invalidRange: The start date must be on or before the end date.
filters.rangeTooLong: Choose a period of at most {{days}} days.

reports.empty: Nothing to report for this period
reports.emptyHint: Try a longer period or other filters.

onlineReason.HUB_OFFLINE: The location hub is not connected to the cloud.

tenant.title: Business
tenant.description: Names and time zone used across all locations.
tenant.currencyHint: Set when the business was created; every amount is stored in it. Its symbol and format are under Language and currency.
tenant.legalNameHint: Registered company name for invoices, if different.
tenant.businessTypeHint: Chosen when the business was set up; it decides which modules start enabled.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Choose which modules your business uses. A location can differ from the business; anything you do not set is inherited.
modules.empty: No module can be changed here. Your plan's modules are managed by $t(common:platform.name).
modules.hiddenNote: Modules outside your plan, or managed by $t(common:platform.name), are not listed.
modules.offDescription: {{module}} is not enabled here. You can turn it on under Settings → Modules.

MODIFIERS.description: Extras, removals and choices on products.

PRODUCT_VARIANTS.name: Product variants

SELF_CHECKOUT.description: Customers order and pay at a kiosk.

CUSTOMER_DISPLAY.name: Customer display
CUSTOMER_DISPLAY.description: A screen facing the customer at the till.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Your business's name, logo, colours and look on every screen: the POS, the kitchen display, the sign-in screens and your website.
branding.displayNameHint: Leave empty to use your business name: {{name}}
branding.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to {{size}}. A wide logo on a transparent background works best.
branding.faviconHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP or ICO, up to {{size}}. Square, at least 32 × 32 pixels.
branding.coloursHint: Text on each colour gets a readable black or white automatically. Colours that would be hard to read on the light or dark screens are refused.
branding.primaryHint: Main buttons, selected items, links and focus outlines.

unreadable.FOREGROUND: Text on this colour would be hard to read ({{ratio}}:1, needs {{required}}:1).
unreadable.DARK: Too dark for dark screens ({{ratio}}:1 against the page, needs {{required}}:1). Choose a lighter shade.
unreadable.LIGHT: Too light for light screens ({{ratio}}:1 against the page, needs {{required}}:1). Choose a darker shade.

branding.themeModeHint: Each screen can still choose its own under Appearance.
branding.screensHint: Give one screen a different look. Anything left on "same as the business" follows the settings above.
branding.saved: Branding saved. Open screens update within a minute.
branding.fileType: This file type is not accepted here.

localization.title: Language and currency
localization.description: The languages your screens and website offer, and how amounts are written on them.
localization.languagesHint: Staff and customers can switch only between the languages you offer. Screens start in the device's own choice, then the staff member's preferred language, then the default.
localization.singleLocale: With one language, every screen and your website hide the language switcher.
localization.defaultLocaleHint: Used by your website and by screens with no other choice.
localization.currencyHint: The currency was chosen when your business was set up and cannot change: every amount is stored in it. You choose how it is written.
localization.decimalPlacesHint: Set by the currency (ISO 4217); not editable.
localization.symbolHint: Leave empty for the currency's own symbol.
localization.displayHint: A symbol you set replaces the symbol in both symbol styles.
localization.formatLocaleHint: Separators and the symbol's position. By default amounts follow the screen's language.
localization.previewHint: An amount and a number as your screens, receipts and website will show them.
localization.saved: Saved. Open screens pick it up within a minute.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Branches, their taxes, cash rounding and kitchen screen timers.
locations.codeHint: 2–10 letters or digits, printed on receipts and order numbers. Cannot change later.
locations.taxInclusiveHint: Menu prices at this location already contain tax.
locations.cashRoundingHint: Smallest coin for cash payments (e.g. 0.05). Empty turns rounding off.
locations.kdsHint: Tickets older than this are flagged on the kitchen screen.
locations.lateAboveWarn: Must be more than the warning time

online.title: Online ordering
online.description: What customers of the website can order from this location, and when.
online.stateHint: Open takes orders within the opening hours; paused shows the location but takes none.
online.hoursHint: In the location's time zone. A closing time at or before the opening time runs past midnight. No hours means no restriction.
online.noHours: No opening hours: open all day while ordering is open.
online.acceptMinutesHint: Orders not accepted in time are cancelled and refunded automatically.

paymentMethods.title: Payment methods
paymentMethods.description: Tenders the POS and website accept. Archived methods stay on past payments.
paymentMethods.typeHint: Cannot change later: recorded payments keep their type.
paymentMethods.providerAccountHint: Website and kiosk payments are recorded under the method linked to the provider that took them.

paymentProviders.title: Payment providers
paymentProviders.description: Who takes online card checkout and kiosk card readers, for the whole business or one location.
paymentProviders.empty: No providers yet. Without an online provider the website takes no card payments: customers pay at pickup or on delivery.
paymentProviders.builtIn: Cash and cards approved on a standalone terminal are built in: they need no provider.
paymentProviders.providerFixed: Fixed once added: to switch providers, disable this one and add another.
paymentProviders.appliesToHint: A location's own provider overrides the business-wide one there.
paymentProviders.modeHint: Test mode moves no real money.

secret.title: Secret
secret.writeOnlyHint: Secrets are encrypted and never shown again, not even to you.
secret.replaceHint: A secret is stored. Type a new one to replace it, or leave the fields empty to keep it.

paymentProviders.enabledHint: A disabled provider takes no new payments; its past payments can still be refunded.

effective.title: In effect at each location
effective.description: What takes each payment at each location, and where that comes from.

none.ONLINE: None: pay at pickup or on delivery

cashRegisters.title: Cash drawers
cashRegisters.description: Drawers at this location. Shifts are opened on a drawer at the POS.

users.title: Users
users.description: People who sign in to the admin portal or the POS, and what their roles let them do.
users.name: Name
users.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Share it privately; the user can be asked to change it.
users.rolesHint: Business-wide roles apply to every location.
users.noRoles: No roles: this user cannot do anything yet.
users.deactivateBody: They are signed out everywhere at once and cannot sign in until reactivated.
users.resetBody: Their current sessions end. Share the new password privately.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Each role is a set of permissions. Nobody can grant permissions they do not hold.
roles.name: Name
roles.systemHint: Holds every permission and cannot be changed.
roles.deleteBody: Only roles nobody holds can be deleted.
roles.notGrantable: You do not hold this permission

website.manage: Edit the website and its domains

kiosk.attend: Attend self-service kiosks (leave the customer screens)

employees.title: Employees
employees.description: Staff who sign in at the POS with a code and PIN. They act with the roles of their linked user.
employees.name: Name
employees.userHint: The employee gets this user's roles at the POS.
employees.pinHint: 4 to 8 digits. Stored encrypted; nobody can read it back.
employees.pinDone: PIN saved. It reaches the location hub within a minute.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Orders of every channel at your locations.
orders.emptyHint: Change the filters to see more.

detail.title: Order {{number}}
detail.hubOwned: This order is managed at the location's POS; changes are made there.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Grouped by phone number from the contact details on orders. There are no customer accounts yet.
customers.name: Name
customers.emptyHint: Customers appear when orders carry a phone number.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Charges and refunds at your locations. Dates are the orders' business days.
payments.refundReasonHint: Required. Shown in the order history and audit log.
payments.atTill: Cash and card refunds are made at the POS, where the drawer is.

shifts.title: Shifts
shifts.description: Cash drawer shifts at this location (read only; shifts are run at the POS).

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: The location's hub, and the terminals and self-service kiosks paired with it.
devices.name: Name
devices.disableBody: Its credential stops working at once. Pair a new hub to replace it.
devices.emptyHint: Pair the location's hub so the POS and kitchen screens work offline.

steps.title: How pairing works
steps.one: Install the location hub on a computer at the location (it runs on the location's network).
steps.two: On that computer, run the pairing command below with an owner's email and this location's code; it asks for the password.
steps.three: The hub downloads the location's menu, staff and settings, then keeps them in sync by itself.
steps.four: Point the POS terminals and kitchen screens at the hub's address on the local network.

devices.credentialHint: Copy it now: it is shown only once and stored only as a hash.
devices.addHint: A hub gets its credential now. A kiosk or screen gets a pairing code to type on it.

typeHints.GATEWAY: The computer that runs the location offline; POS terminals and screens connect to it.
typeHints.KIOSK: A touch screen where customers order and pay by themselves.
typeHints.POS: A till, identified at the hub (staff still sign in with their PIN).
typeHints.KDS: A kitchen screen, identified at the hub.
typeHints.CUSTOMER_DISPLAY: A screen facing the customer at a till.

devices.pairingHint: Type this code on the device. It works once, at this location's hub, until {{time}}.
devices.kioskSteps: On the kiosk, open the kiosk app from the hub (port 5176 in development) and type the code. The hub pairs it even without the internet.

sync.title: Synchronization
sync.description: The location hub's link to the cloud, and the changes the cloud refused from it.
sync.noHub: No hub is paired with this location.
sync.noIssuesHint: Every change from the locations reached the cloud.

detail.title: Refused change
detail.rule: Nothing is overwritten silently. Compare both versions and choose; the version that loses is kept in the audit log, and the location hub follows your decision automatically.
detail.noHubVersion: Not kept (refused before this was recorded).
detail.noteHint: Required: why this is the right choice.

actions.RESEND: Ask the hub to send it again

explain.APPLY_HUB: The location's state replaces the cloud's; the cloud's copy is saved in the audit log first.
explain.KEEP_CLOUD: The hub replaces its copy with the cloud's; its refused change stays on record.
explain.RESEND: For when the cause was fixed elsewhere; the cloud checks the change again.

detail.done: Decision recorded. The hub follows it within a minute.
detail.noResolve: You can view this issue, but resolving it needs the “Resolve sync conflicts” permission.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who did what, when and from where. Secrets are never shown.
audit.actionHint: Exact action or a prefix ending in a dot, e.g. order.

reasons.EMAIL_TAKEN: This email is already in use.
reasons.ACCOUNT_SHARED: This person also signs into other brands, so their password cannot be changed here.
reasons.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a member of the organization.
reasons.TENANT_IN_ORGANIZATION: This brand already belongs to another organization.
reasons.ORGANIZATION_LINK_FAILED: This brand was created, but its organization members could not be linked. Attach the brand to the organization again.
reasons.SELF: You cannot do this to your own account.
reasons.LAST_OWNER: The business needs at least one active owner.
reasons.ESCALATION: You cannot grant or remove permissions you do not hold.
reasons.IN_USE: Remove this role from its users first.
reasons.NAME_TAKEN: A role with this name exists.
reasons.CODE_TAKEN: This employee code is in use.
reasons.USER_LINKED: This user is already linked to another employee.
reasons.LAST_CASH_METHOD: Keep at least one cash method.
reasons.SHIFT_OPEN: Close the drawer's shift at the POS first.
reasons.IN_STORE_METHOD: Refund this payment at the POS.
reasons.AWAITING_ACCEPTANCE: The order is still waiting for the business.
reasons.EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE: That is more than can be refunded.
reasons.PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: No online payment provider is set up.
reasons.OWNED_BY_LOCATION: This order is managed at the location's POS.
reasons.APPLY_FAILED: The location's version could not be applied (it clashes with another record). Fix the cause, then ask the hub to resend.
reasons.INVALID_HUB_VERSION: The location's version is not valid data.
reasons.NOT_A_CONFLICT: Only version conflicts can take the location's version.
reasons.NO_HUB_VERSION: The location's version was not kept.
reasons.ORDERS_ONLY: Only orders can take the cloud's version.
reasons.NOT_IN_CLOUD: The cloud has no copy to keep: the sale would be lost.
reasons.HUB_HAS_PAYMENTS: The location's version has payments the cloud has not recorded.
reasons.HUB_DISABLED: The hub that sent it is disabled.
reasons.ALREADY_ADDED: This domain is already on the list.
reasons.OTHER_TENANT: Another business already uses this domain.
reasons.PLATFORM_DOMAIN: $t(common:platform.name) addresses cannot be added as your own domain.
reasons.SINGLE_LABEL: Enter a full domain, such as www.example.com.
reasons.IP_ADDRESS: Enter a domain name, not an IP address.
reasons.TOO_MANY: You have the most custom domains allowed.

website.title: Website
website.description: What visitors see on your website. Changes stay in the draft until you publish them.

status.never: Not published yet: visitors see $t(common:platform.name)'s starting website for your business.
status.hint: Save keeps your draft; Preview opens your site with the draft for 30 minutes; Publish shows it to everyone.

website.saved: Draft saved. Visitors do not see it until you publish.
website.invalid: Some fields are not valid yet. Check the highlighted section.
website.sectionsHint: Switch sections on or off and put them in order.
website.noSelection: Choose a section to edit it.

typeHints.HERO: The first thing visitors see: a title, a line under it, a button and a picture.
typeHints.FEATURED_PRODUCTS: Products from a branch's menu, with their prices. Choose none to show the first available ones.
typeHints.CATEGORIES: Your menu's categories, each opening the menu there. Choose none to show them all.
typeHints.ABOUT: A few words about the business, with a picture.
typeHints.GALLERY: Pictures of the place, the food or the products.
typeHints.LOCATIONS: Your branches, whether they take orders now, and the way to their menus.
typeHints.OPENING_HOURS: The opening hours of one branch, or of each.
typeHints.PROMO_BANNER: A short message that stands out, with an optional button.
typeHints.FOOTER: The last block of the page: your text, the navigation and the social links.

fields.title: Title
fields.subtitle: Subtitle
fields.hrefHint: A section (#locations), a page (/track) or an https:// address.
fields.imageHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
fields.productsHint: Up to {{max}}. None chosen: the first available products.
fields.categoriesHint: None chosen: every category with products.
fields.caption: Caption
fields.author: Name

site.navigationHint: The links in the header and the footer.
site.seoHint: The page title and description search results and link previews show.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: The addresses your website answers on. Only verified domains show your site.
domains.addHint: Up to {{max}} domains you own. You will add a DNS record to prove it is yours.
domains.instructions: Add this TXT record at your domain's DNS provider, then verify. DNS changes can take a while to appear.
domains.pointHint: To serve the site, also point the domain (CNAME or A record) at $t(common:platform.name), as your onboarding guide says.
